description:
Lists which procurement procedure types are permitted for a contract, each with status frei (permitted), voraussetzung (permitted under conditions) or nein (not permitted) and its legal basis (GWB, VgV, UVgO; rules as of 2026-08-15). Intended for requests where the user asks which procedure type may or must be used for a given contract value, authority type and service category. Considers EU thresholds, the sub-threshold regime and special cases (single supplier, urgency, previous call without bids). With `bundesland` (e.g. BY or Bayern) the sub-threshold rules are chosen per state: federal authorities → UVgO, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern → its state rules, other states → general guidance plus the state law to check. The result is guidance; the choice of procedure stays with the contracting authority. Deadlines are calculated by calculate_tender_deadline, bid scoring by score_bids.

Example user questions: "Welche Verfahrensart darf ich wählen?"; "Ist ein Verhandlungsverfahren zulässig?"; "Darf ich freihändig vergeben?"; "Wann ist ein Direktauftrag erlaubt?"; "Offenes oder nicht offenes Verfahren?"

alleinstellung.description: Only one company can provide the service (sole source / exclusive rights).

auftraggeber.description: Type of contracting authority (same as in schwellenwert).

bundesland.description: Federal state of the contracting authority, code or name (BY, Bayern, NW, Nordrhein-Westfalen …). Selects the sub-threshold rules automatically.

keineAngebote.description: Prior call for competition yielded no (acceptable) tenders.

leistungsart.description: Type of service (same as in schwellenwert).

nichtBeschreibbar.description: Service cannot be specified sufficiently / requires conceptual or innovative solutions.

regelwerk.description: Optional override of the sub-threshold framework: mv=Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, bund=federal authority, anders=any other state (generic guidance). Usually empty, since bundesland selects the framework. Only relevant below the EU threshold.
